name: get_snp_profile
description: Extract the 10 pharmacogenomic rsIDs from a patient's 23andMe genome file. Always call this first.

name: fetch_whoop
description: Get 30-day biometric data — HRV trend, RHR, recovery, SpO2. Confirms whether medication is producing physiological improvement.

name: fetch_glucose
description: Get 30-day CGM glucose data — time in range, avg glucose, GMI, trend direction, hypoglycemic events. Time in range below 70% = poor control. Call alongside fetch_whoop.

name: fetch_pharmgkb
description: Get drug-gene interaction evidence for a list of genes. Returns evidence level 1A-4, drug, effect, mechanism.

name: fetch_clinvar
description: Get clinical significance for a list of rsIDs.

name: fetch_pubmed
description: Get top abstracts and real PMIDs for a gene-drug pair. Call this for every claim you make.

name: fetch_rxnorm
description: Check current medications for genotype-driven contraindications.

name: fetch_trials
description: Find active recruiting trials matching a gene and zip code.

name: check_safety_flags
description: Mandatory deterministic safety check — SLCO1B1, CYP2C19, VKORC1 gates.

name: generate_brief
description: Generate the final clinician brief. Only callable after check_safety_flags.
